tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /lam sbas bshad kyi khrid yig gong ma'i gsung gi bdud rtsi man ngag gi rgya mtsho zhes bya ba bzhugs// na mo gu ru buddha dhwa dza ye/ dus gsum sgrib med gzigs pa'i mus pa rje/ /sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan zhabs la gus btud nas/ /sa skya'i lcags ri'i khong las mi 'da' ba'i/ /chos bzhi'i nang tshan zab mo sbas bshad kyi/ /man ngag don rnams rtsod bral gong ma yi/ /gsung gi bdud rtsi slob ma'i tshogs rnams kyis/ /legs par bris rnams lhan cig bsdebs pa yi/ /zab yangs man ngag rgya mtsho 'dir spel lo/ /zhes mchod par brjod cing rtsom par dam bcas nas/ 'dir lam sbas bshad kyi khrid yig gong ma'i gsung gi bdud rtsi man ngag gi rgya mtsho zhes bya ba 'di 'chad pa la spyi don rnam pa bzhi ste/ dpal gyi rgyal mtshan pa'i gsung rab las 'byung tshul bshad pa/ kun dga' blo gros kyi gsung rab las 'byung tshul bshad pa/ bdag chen chos rje'i gsung rab las 'byung tshul bshad pa/ kun dga' lhun grub kyi zin bris las 'byung tshul bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ chos rje rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po'i gsung la mkhas pa dpal gyi rgyal mtshan gyis zin bris su mdzad pa'i lam sbas bshad kyi khrid yig las 'di ltar 'byung ste/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lam zab mo sbas te bshad pa 'di la phyag chen mchog gi dngos grub bsgrub pa'i gdam ngag dang / thun mong gi dngos grub bsgrub pa'i gdam ngag gnyis/ dang po la sngon 'gro dang / dngos gzhi'i rnal 'byor gnyis/ dang po ni/ lam 'bras kyi gzhung ji lta ba'i khrid bzhin du/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed maṇḍal dang yig brgya'i rnal 'byor rnams bya/ 'di'i khrid yig phyi ma kha cig tu/ bsam gtan gyi yan lag dgu byed par bshad pa ni rdzogs rim spyi'i sngon 'gro yin pas 'gal ba cher med mod/ de lta na'ang 'di'i sngon du byed pa'i phyag len dang bshad pa med do/

/yang bla ma kha cig 'di dang lam rdo rje'i rba rlabs gnyis gcig pas 'di'i sngon du rlung gi rnal 'byor bdun la lo bdun la sogs pa sbyong dgos zer ba ni/ mi 'thad de/ lam rdo rje rba rlabs kyi sngon du rlung gi rnal 'byor bdun la sbyang ba ni/ rlung gi rnal 'byor dang phyag rgya'i rnal 'byor phyogs gcig tu nyams su len pa'i dbang du byas pa yin la/ 'di dang lam rdo rje'i rba rlabs mi gcig cing / 'di la lam sbas bshad zer ba ni/ gsung ngag lam 'bras su sbas pa 'dir bshad pas de skad zer ba yin no/ /'di nyams su len pa po'i gang zag ni/ dbang po shin tu rno ba'i gang zag kyai rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba thob pa gcig gis nyams su len rgyu yin te/ rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug sa skya pa chen pos/ rgya gar sindhu'i dge slong gcig la dbang bskur nas bstan pas/ zla ba drug nas mngon shes dang rdzu 'phrul byung / tshe 'di la grub pa thob pa lta bu'o/ /ding sang bla mas ston pa'i go rim gyi dbang du byas na/ bla ma rang nyid la gsung ngag lam 'bras thob pa'i slob ma gcig la ston pa yin gyi/ gang thod thod la mi ston no/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i rnal 'byor la/ bskyed rim dang / rdzogs rim dang / bla mas dbang bskur ba'i dus su bdag nyid kyi phung khams skye mched rnams lhar gsal zhing / de bzhin gshegs pa spyan drangs te de la bstim ste/ rab tu gnas pa byas shing byin rlabs can du byas pa bzhin/ bdag nyid kyis kyang lhar bsgoms pas/ bdag nyid skad cig gis kyai rdo rje'i zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa yum dang bcas pa lam ste bsgom/ dmigs pa gcig go /gnyis pa la/ rtsa ba'i dmigs pa dang yan lag gi dmigs pa'o/ /dang po la mnyam gzhag dang / rjes thob gnyis kyi dang po la/ rtsa ba lus kyi gnad/ bsgom pa dmigs pa'i gnad/ dgang ba rlung gi gnad do/ /dang po ni/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngon du song nas/

shing ngam sa las byas pa'i 'khor lo/ zheng mtheb mdzub gnyis sbyar ba'i bar du tshud cing / dpangs su sor drug pa/ rtse mo cung zad phra ba phyag len bzhin du bcas te srin po'i lam gyi thad sor bzhag la/ brla re mos su 'degs pa dang / 'og rlung nang du 'dren pa bstun te cung zad mthos pas mi bde na smad/ bde na rang so bzung / rkang pa gnyis skyil krung glang po che'i rna ba ltar bcas/ lag pa gnyis pus mo la bkab ste/ rgal tshigs drang por bsrangs/ mig 'dzum pa med par bar snang la blta ba sogs bsam gtan gyi 'dug stangs kyis 'dug go /gnyis pa la rang nyid yi dam gyi lhar gsal ba'i lus kyi dbus drang po ru/ rang gi don snying lnga'i nang gi glo ba de padma dkar po 'dab ma brgyad pa kha gyen du bstan pa/ mchin pa padma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa kha thur du bstan pa ste/ de gnyis rtse mo cung zad bsnol ba gur phub kyi rnam pa lta bu bsgom la/ 'di nyid gzhal yas khang yin no snyam du mos pa byed/ sbyang gzhi la glo ba steng na yod kyi sgom dus 'og tu bsgom pa gnad yin gsungs dmigs pa gcig go /de nas de'i nang du/ rdo rje'i lus kyi gnas lugs la snying kha thur la bltas yod kyang / blos gyen du bstan par bsam/ de'i dbus na yar/ rtsa ro rkyang kun 'dar ma gsum gsal btab/ dbus drang por dbu ma la ro rkyang gnyis kyis dkris pa'i mdud pa yi ge hūm̐ gi dbyibs lta bu mgo thur du bstan pa gsal btab bo/ /dmigs pa gcig go /de gsal ba dang / hūm̐ de las thugs rdo rje/ sku mdog sngo nag mche ba gtsigs pa spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ zhabs gnyis bgrad nas bzhugs pa/ phyag rgya drug gis spras pa/ che chung tshon gang pa gcig bsgom mo/ /gcig go /'dir khrid yig phyi ma kha cig tu/ he ru ka'i spyan gsum gyi g.yas nyi ma/

g.yon zla ba/ dbus sgra gcan du byas pa dang / phyag g.yas su nyi ma dang / g.yon du zla ba 'dzin pa byas pa ni/ don spyi ma go ba yin te/ de'i don spyi ni/ phyi nang sbyar ba'i bshad pa ni yin te/ phyi rol tu nam mkha' stong pa la nyi ma dang zla ba sgra gcan gsum las/ nyi zla gnyis rlung 'gros kyi g.yas bskor dang / rang 'gros kyi g.yon bskor du ri rab la bskor zhing / sgra gcan rang 'gros kyi g.yas bskor du bskor la/ dgun gtso bor gyur pa'i zla ba drug dbyar gtso bor gyur pa'i zla ba drug gi bar du sgra gcan dang zla ba gnyis 'phrad cing / de yang gzung gi mdo dang / thar lam las bsgyur ba'i mdo sna cig gsum du grags pa der/ sgra gcan gyi khar mid nas lkog mar 'don pa bshad cing / 'di pa'i lugs kyi bshad pa 'di yang de dang nye la/ dus 'khor du/ mgo la sgra gcan dang / mjug ma la dus mes brda chad byas nas/ de gnyis kyis sgrib par bshad la/ don la gang gnas kyang ri mo la de ltar du 'char te/ dper na rgya nag pa rnams/ nyi zla gnyis nyin mo nam mkha' dang / mtshan mo sa 'og nas bskor ba byed par 'dod cing / /rtsis la'ang 'char bzhin no/ /de ltar na nyi zla dang sgra gcan gnyis 'phrad pa las/ gnas skabs 'ga' zhig tu/ lo legs pa dang / skya rgyal ba dang / nad med pa sogs kyi dge ba'i bya ba byed la/ 'ga' zhig tu/ 'jig rten gyi khams su nad dang mu ge bskyed pa la sogs pa mi dge ba'i bya ba byed do/ /de bzhin du nang du rdo rje'i lus la/ phyi rol gyi nam mkha' dang 'dra ba'i kha dang bshang sgo la sogs pa'i bu ga nam mkha' rnams dang / nyi ma dang 'dra ba'i rtsa ro ma/ khams dmar cha la sogs te g.yas kyi cha rnams so/ /zla ba dang 'dra ba'i rkyang ma dang / khams dkar cha dang / des mtshon nas g.yon gyi cha rnams so/ /rang 'gros dang 'dra ba'i khams dkar mar rnams thur du babs pa dang / rlung 'gros dang 'dra ba'i rlung rnams gyen du rgyu ba'o/

/sgra gcan dang 'dra ba'i thugs rdo rje'i hūm̐ yig dge ba'i bya ba byed pa dang 'dra bar/ snying kha'i hūm̐ las khams dkar dmar dang rlung 'byung 'jug sogs thim pa la brten nas/ mi rtog pa'i ye shes skyed par byed do/ /de nyid gsang ba sems la sbyar na/ nam mkha' stong pa dang 'dra ba'i sems kyi chos nyid spros pa'i mtha' dang bral ba'i de bzhin nyid/ nyi zla dang 'dra ba'i gzung 'dzin gyi rnam par rtog pa/ sgra gcan dang 'dra ba'i rtsa dbu ma/ dge ba'i bya ba byed pa dang 'dra ba'i dbu ma'i nang du gzung 'dzin gyi rnam rtog bkag pas/ bde stong mi rtog pa'i ye shes skyed par byed do/ /gsum pa dgang ba rlung gi gnad ni/ sgom chen pa rnams kyi brda chad la/ rlung 'dzin lugs sa len ma zhes pa'i lugs su byas te/ steng rlung cung zad drag tu rngub kha sbyor bya/ de yang rlung lte bar mnan cing / sems kyi dmigs pa snying kha'i he ru ka la gtad/ rlung mar 'phul bas/ 'khar sder chus bkang ba'i 'khar sder la dbyug pa bsnun pas chu 'phar ba bzhin/ he ru ka cung zad g.yo bar bsgom zhing rlung thub tshad du bzung / mi thub na dal bus btang / de lta thun re re la rlung sbyor nyi shu rtsa gcig tsam bya/ de'i tshe phyir rol tu snang ba dkar lam lam pa'am/ dmar 'khrug 'khrug pa 'ba' zhig byung na/ rlung gi rtags yin pas rlung bcos bya/ cung zad glod/ snang ba dkar po dang dmar po la sogs pa byung na nyams snang yin pas byung rgyal du bskyang ngo / /gnyis pa rjes thob kyi dmigs pa la/ mkhal 'degs rigs gsum spyi gtsug dang / /phan tshun brkyang gsum lus zungs bskyed/ /dpung 'degs rigs gnyis gang na sel/ /gtun brdung rtsa ba'i 'khrul 'khor ro/ /zhes pa rtsa ba'i 'phrul 'khor bdun phyag len ltar bya/ 'di la bla ma phyi ma kha cig gis/ lus zungs bskyed pa la thugs rje chen po zhes sogs kyi ming btags nas/

'dir bshad pa dang 'dra la 'dra min byed pa ches 'chugs pa yin no/ /mdor bsdus pa ni/ rtsa ba'i 'khrul 'khor bdun po 'dis chog la/ rgyas par na de'i steng du thig le 'dzin dang gling bzhi bsdud/ /gtun shing rigs gnyis gtun brdungs gzhan/ /mda' gzhu rigs gsum nyi zla gnyis/ /bcu ni yan lag 'khrul 'khor yin/ /rkang dkrugs gtun brdungs zhags pa gnyis/ /rnam grol chu srin zhal shes bcas/ /mdun rgyab 'dril ba rigs gnyis te/ /yan lag 'phrul 'khor yan lag brgyad/ /rtsa ba'i 'phrul 'khor bcu gnyis la/ /yan lag 'khrul 'khor rnam pa bcu/ /yan lag gi ni yan lag brgyad/ /sbas bshad 'khrul 'khor sum cur bshad/ /ces pa ltar yan lag gi 'phrul 'khor rnams kyang byas na bzang ste/ man ngag 'di'i rigs la 'phrul 'khor mang na gegs med cing ting nge 'dzin myur du bskyed pa la phan pa yin no/ /'di rnams kyi phyag len ni nyan chen pa'i dngos slob dkar po brag pa rin chen seṅge nas brgyud pa'i phyag len/ mang mkhar bya tshangs lung pa'i bla ma rgyal mtshan 'bum la chos rje bla mas zhus/ de la bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims kyis zhus nas yi ger bkod pa bzhin shes par bya'o/ /de dag ni khams 'dus pa rlung dang gtum mo drod rtags kyi lam khrid pa'i dod do/ /gnyis pa bogs 'byin nam yan lag gi dmigs pa ni/ rkang pa gnyis rdo rje'i skyil krung bcas/ lag pa gnyis rdo rje khu tshur nu ma'i steng du bsnol/ sngar ltar he ru ka yab yum du gsal ba'i spyi gtsug nas rdo rje nor bu'i rtse mo'i bar rtsa dbu ma zang thal du yod par bsgom/ rigs kyi bdag po'i rtser bdud bzhis zil gyis mi gnon pa'i hūm̐ yig me 'bar bar bsgom/ de nas rgya mtsho ri rab la sbyar/ ro 'dzin rang gi gnas su bskyal/ dbang po'i dwangs ma gyen du bsgrangs la/ stobs kyi hūm̐ drag la ring ba 'then zhing / de'i tshe bdud bzhis zil gyis mi gnon pa'i hūm̐ yig de las hūm̐ de 'dra ba me 'bar ba rab tu mang po rim pa bzhin byung /

dbu ma'i nang la yar zhugs/ spyi bo'i haṃ yig la reg de'i tshe lus kyi 'khrul 'khor rnams slod/ them bu btang pa ltar/ haṃ las byang chub kyi sems 'dzag spyi bo'i rtsa 'dab sum cu so gnyis gang / dbu ma'i nang na mar babs/ mgrin pa'i rtsa 'dab rnams gang / de bzhin du rims kyis byung nas snying kha dang / lte ba'i rtsa 'dab rnams gang / mthar lus thams cad gang bas/ sems nyid bde ba chen po'i ye shes kyi ngo bor skyes/ bde chen gyi ye shes de nyid rang bzhin stong pa nyid las ma 'das kyang / bde ba'i rnam pa mi 'gog de ltar bde bzhin pa'i ngang nas stong pa'i ngor gnas/ stong bzhin pa'i ngang nas bde ba'i rnam pa mi 'gog pa ste/ sems nyid bde stong gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bor skyes par bsgom zhing / de nyid gzugs kyi rnam pa 'ja' tshon lta bu'i sku mtshan dang dpe byad kyis spras pa'i he ru ka zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa yum dang bcas par bsgom zhing de lta bu'i zung 'jug gi ngang la mnyam par bzhag cing bskyangs pas/ zla ba drug la sogs pa nas bden pa mthong ba'i ye shes skye'o/ /de ni khams 'dus pa bar pa thig le bde stong gi lam khrid pa'i dod do/ /'dir dngos su las kyi phyag rgya dang / ye shes kyi phyag rgya gnyis gang la yang brten pa'i gsal kha ma byung kyang / don gyi ye shes kyi phyag rgya bsten par song te/ bdud bzhis zil gyis mi gnon pa'i hūm̐ yig bsgom pa'i rigs kyi bdag po de/ yum gyi padmar nub par bsgom pas so/ /slar yang dbu ma'i nang na yar hūm̐ yig 'bar bar 'phro bar bsgom pa ni/ khams 'dus pa tha ma skyon med gnyug ma ye shes kyi lam khrid pa'i dod do/ /'di dbang bzhi'i lam gcig tu nyams su len pa'i gdam ngag yin zhes gsungs pa ni/ skad cig gis he ru ka yab yum du bsgom pa bum dbang gi lam/ snying kha chos kyi 'khor lo la gnad du bsnun pa rnams gsang dbang gi lam/

hūm̐ yig 'bar ba spros te byang chub kyi sems phab pas lus kyi rtsa gnas rnams gang bar bsgom pa dbang gsum pa'i lam/ slar yang hūm̐ yig me 'bar ba gyen du 'phro bar bsgom pa ni dbang bzhi pa'i lam mo/ /thun rjes rnams su/ dge ba 'di yis nam mkha'i mtha' klas pa'i/ /lus can kun gyis bsod nams ye shes tshogs/ /myur du bsgrubs nas tshe 'di kho na la/ /rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang myur thob shog /ces pas dge ba'i rtsa ba sangs rgyas kyi sar bsngo/ de las langs nas rjes spyod lam gyi rnal 'byor rnams bya zhing / thun mtshams su yang chos mthun gyi bya bas dus 'da' bar bya'o/ /zhib par ni chos rje sa paṇa gyis mdzad pa'i khrid yig tu blta bar bya'o/ /lam sbas bshad kyi dmigs pa'i bsgrigs rim dang go rgyu'i bshad pa cung zad yi ger bkod pa 'di rtsod pa'i dus kyi thams cad mkhyen pa gnyis pa rje btsun mkhas pa'i dbang po kun dga' bzang po'i gsung gi bdud rtsi rgya mtsho las/ chu thigs tsam lon pa rang dang gzhan la phan pa'i phyir du snyoms las pa dpal gyi rgyal mtshan gyis zin bris su btab pa'o/ /bdag blo dang po'i las can gti mug pas/ /'di la nongs gyur dpal ldan bla ma dang / /bka' bsrung mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la bzod par gsol/ /dge bas rdo rje'i 'dzin pa'i sa thob shog /ces pa de rnams kyis dpal gyi rgyal mtshan gyi gsung rab las 'byung tshul bstan zin nas/ spyi don gnyis pa kun dga' blo gros kyi gsung rab las 'byung tshul bshad pa ni/ rje btsun kun dga' bzang po'i gsung la/ srad pa kun blos zin bris su btab pa'i lam sbas bshad kyi khrid yig las 'di ltar 'byung ste/ rje btsun bla ma thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa'i zhabs la spyi bos gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /'dir lam zab mo sbas te bshad pa'i gdams ngag 'chad pa la/ sbas bshad ces bya ba'i nges tshig ni/ kha cig rdo rje'i rba rlabs kho na'i gdam ngag yin pa'i phyir/

sbas bshad ces bya zer/ bla ma yang dgon pas 'di la brten pa'i rdo rje rba rlabs kyi gdam ngag bya ba brtsams/ de la khang ston 'od zer rgyal mtshan na re/ gser dang ra gan bsres pa yi/ /gdam ngag yang dgon pa yis byas/ /zer ba de shin tu mad pa yin/ rang gi ngo bo su thod thod la mi gnang bar skal ldan la sbas pa'i tshul gyis gnang bas de skad ces bya'o/ /de lta bu'i gdam ngag 'di rgyud gang la brten snyam na/ kha cig lam 'bras rba rlabs kyi bshad pa yod la/ lag len med pa'i gdam ngag yin pas/ de'i rba rlabs kyi nyams len yin zer ro/ /de ni ma yin te/ lam 'bras su g.yas bzung ba'i rba rlabs kyi lag len gsal bar bshad pa'i phyir ro/ /'di la chos rje pa'i yig cha gnyis yod pa'i/ gcig la bar skabs su yig phreng gcig tsam la/ rang dges 'di mchan dkyus shor yin nam dogs ni dogs pa rdo rje'am/ 'khor lo bde mchog gi gang rung du bsgom bya ba 'byung / gcig la rang lhar bsgom bya ba las gsal kha mi snang / dang po'i yig cha rnying pa gcig dang / dkar gyi yig cha las kyang kyai rdor ram/ bde mchog gang rung du bsgom bya ba bshad pas de gnyis thun mong gi gdam ngag yin no/ /'o na de lta bu'i gdam ngag 'di bla ma brgyud pa gang las 'ong snyam na/ 'di ni rje sa chen nyid la rnal 'byor dbang phyug gis lcags ri khong gi zab chos/ lam sbas bshad/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi byin rlabs/ bir srung / rnam 'joms bir lugs te bzhi gnang ba'i dang po lam sbas bshad bya ba yin pas/ sa skya pa chen po las 'ongs pa'o/ /brgyud pa dang ldan pa'i gdam ngag la gsum/ sngon 'gro/ dngos gzhi/ rjes so/ /dang po la gnyis khrid kyi sngon 'gro bsag sbyang bya ba/ thun gyi sngon 'gro bsam gtan gyi yan lag dgu'o/ /sngon 'gro 'di gnyis chos rje pa'i khrid yig las zur tsam las mi snang yang / lam 'bras ltar 'dir yang cis kyang sngon 'gro gnyis dgos par snang bas/

dang po la gnyis kyi sdig pa sbyang ba ni/ rang gnas dben par 'jig rten gyi bya ba thams cad ltos pa med par spangs te/ dges pa rdo rje'am/ bde mchog gang rung gi phyi dkyil du dbang thob cing dam tshig dang ldan pa/ lha'i rnal 'byor dang bcas pas stan bde ba la 'dug ste/ skyabs su 'gro ba dang byang chub tu sems bskyed par bya/ sems bskyed tshigs bcad du byed na/ sngags kyi skur ni 'gyur ba yis/ /sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /bdag ni he ru kar bsgyur nas/ /gzhan yang he ru ka dpal gyi/ /go 'phang mchog la dgod par bgyi/ /zhes brjod/ de nas rang gi spyi bor pad zla'i steng du skad cig gis rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ lam 'bras ltar na/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung / nges brjod bla ma ltar na/ g.yas brkyang gis bzhugs pa/ gnyis ka sa skya pa'i man ngag yin pas gang bde bya/ rus pa'i rgyan cha drug dang ldan pa/ yum rdo rje snyem ma dkar mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ rus pa'i rgyan lnga dang ldan pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i sku can du bsgom/ yab kyi thugs khar de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ye shes kyi ngo bo hūm̐ dkar po bsam/ de las 'od 'phros phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs kha nas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi spyan drangs/ de la thim/ yab kyi sku lus las bdud rtsi'i rgyun yum gyi mkhar babs/ de'i mthus yum gyi sku las kyang bdud rtsi babs mkhar byon/ yab yum gnyis kyi sbyor mtshams nas bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas/ bdag gi sdig pa dang / khyad par du ting 'dzin skye ba la bar chad byed pa'i sgrib pa thams cad dud khu dang rnag khrag gi rnam pas bshang lam dang rkang mthil nas 'thon/ de shul yab kyi thugs kha'i hūm̐ las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas gang bar bsam zhing / ting nge 'dzin de'i ngang la blo gzhag go

/gal te 'jog par mi nus na/ stong pa'i rang bzhin gyi sngags bzlas te/ oṃ shrī badzra he ru ka sa ma ya/ ma nu pa la ya/ badzra he ru ka two no pa tiṣṭa ḍi ddho me bha wa/ su to ṣyo me bha wa/ a nu rakto me bha wa/ su po ṣyo me bha wa/ sarba siddhi me pra yatstsha/ sarba karma su tsa me/ tsittaṃ shrī yaṃ ku ru hūm̐/ ha ha ha ha hoḥ bha ga wan badzra he ru ka ma me muñtsa he ru ko bha wa mahā sa ma ya satwa aḥ zhes pa lnga brgya la sogs pa brjod/ mthar rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum rten gyi stobs su mos la stobs gzhan gsum yang tshang bas/ bdag ni mi shes rmongs pa ste/ /zhes sogs brjod/ sku gsung thugs rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig nyams pa thams cad mthol lo bshags so/ /sdig pa dang sgrib pa nyes pa ltung ba dri ma'i tshogs thams cad byang zhing dag par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes brjod/ de nas rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum 'od du zhu/ rang gi lus ngag yid gsum la thim par bsam pa ste/ sdig pa sbyang ba'i phyir rdo rje sems dpa' bsgom bzlas bya'o/ /gnyis pa tshogs bsags pa ni/ yig brgya'i rjes thogs nyid la byed na/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed bya mi dgos/ zur du byed na sngar bzhin skyabs su 'gro ba dang sems bskyed pa byas pa/ mdun gyi nam mkhar rin po che las grub pa'i khri'i steng du rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang gi rnam pa sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa'i sku can du bsgom/ de'i thugs kha nas 'od zer 'phros phyogs bcu'i bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad la phog de dag 'od du zhu bla ma rdo rje 'chang la thim pas/ bla ma de sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo yin par mos/ gzhan yang mdun gyi nam mkhar rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems kyi tshogs dang bcas pa dpag tu med pa mngon sum bzhin bzhugs par bsam la/

de dag la rang gi lus longs spyod kyis bsdus pa'i dngos po thams cad ltos pa med par dbul/ phyi kun rdzob rdzas kyi maṇḍal yang bya ste/ rin po che la byas pa'am/ 'khar ba'am/ shing ngam/ de ma 'byor na/ ras kha gang pa gcig gi zur bltabs te zlum po byas pa'i maṇḍal 'dus byas la/ oṃ badzra bhu mi āḥhūm̐/ zhes pas gser gyi sa gzhi rnam pa rdo rje'i rang bzhin can gcig bsam/ oṃ badzra re ṣe āḥhūm̐/ zhes pas lcags ri/ hūm̐ zhes pas bar chad bsal la/ dbus su ri'i rgyal po ri rab/ shar lus 'phags po/ lho 'dzam bu gling / nub ba lang spyod/ byang sgra mi snyan/ zhes brjod cing / de rnams su tshom bu re re bzhag shar dang dbus kyi bar du nyi ma/ dbus dang nub kyi bar du zla ba ste tshom bu re bzhag yang dbus su tshom bu gcig bzhag la/ lha dang mi'i dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa ma tshang ba med pa 'di nyid rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i bla ma dam pa rnams dang / sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams la dbul ba bgyi'o/ /thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol/ bzhes nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes brjod/ tshom bu rnams gser dngul sogs rin po che dang / tsanda sogs sman yin na de dag phyogs 'di na dkon pa'i phyir yang yang bzlas te phul bas chog mod pa'i rdzas nas sogs yin na lan re re bzhin brjes/ zhes bshad pas de bzhin du bya/ de nas chos rje pas mdzad pa'i/ zhing khams rin chen dam pa 'dir/ /zhes pa sogs brjod pa'am/ gang blo la yod pa'i tshigs bcad 'don/ de ltar maṇḍal brgya la sogs pa phul ba'i mthar/ bla ma dam pa brgyud pa dang bcas pa la gsol ba 'debs so/ /dpal ldan bla ma dam pa brgyud pa dang bcas pas bdag gi rgyud la ting nge 'dzin khyad par can skye bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes lan mang du brjod/ de tsam las mi nus par gyur pa de'i tshe/ tshogs bsags pa'i zhing rnams mi dmigs par bsam pa ste/

tshogs bsag pa'i phyir maṇḍal dbul ba'o/ /sngon 'gro gnyis pa ni/ rim gnyis gcig char du bsgom pa'am/ dbang bzhi gdan thog gcig tu bsgom pa'i man ngag 'di ni snying kha'i rtsa mdud rnams rim gyis myur du grol bar 'phrul 'khor gyi rnal 'byor gtso che ba yin/ lam 'di'i gnad shes pa'i gang zag zla ba drug la sogs pas grol bar 'gyur ba yin/ de yang rgya gar sindhu'i yul gyi dge slong zhig gis so mā na thar rnal 'byor pa gcig gi drung du phyin pa dang / de na re/ dge slong khyod byang phyogs na rnal 'byor dbang phyug gi sprul pa sa skya pa chen po zhes bya ba yod kyis/ de can du song zhig dang / myur du bden pa mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes lung bstan/ des 'ongs pas sa chen gung thang na la rtse gnas po che na bzhugs pa dang mjal/ man ngag 'di gnang bas zla ba drug na grol lo/ /de ltar myur ba'i lam 'di'i sngon du bsam gtan gyi yan lag dgu 'gro dgos pas lus sbyang ba ni/ rang gi gnas khang srung 'khor gyi nang du tshud par bsam/ rang dpal kyai rdor rjer gsal ba tsam rgyun du dran par bya/ kha cig na re/ bar chad mi 'byung ba'i phyir lus ngag yid kyi gnas/ spyi mgrin snying kha gsum du oṃ āḥhūṃ dgod pa dang / 'khor gyi lha mo rnams kyang gsal gdab dgos zer te/ byas kyang mi 'gal mod/ 'on kyang de tsam mi dgos/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed byas la/ ma dā ni'i sbyor ba bya ba/ lag mthil gnyis drod thon thon shud pa'i thad thog mar mig la gdab/ de nas tshigs thams cad mnye'o/ lus gyong shes che ba la mar gyis byug pa dang / chang gis byug pa dang / shin tu gyong na dkyil 'khor chen po'i sbyor ba bya ba/ mi'i klad pa cung zad cig chang la sbyar bas byug des mnyen lcug ge 'gro/ de nas skyil krung bcas la rlung ro phyir 'bud/ de'i rjes la lag pa gnyis rdo rje khu tshur bcangs pa nu ma gnyis kyi steng du bzhag la/

'og rlung 'then te rlung mnan la rlung kha sbyar bya/ lam 'bras su rlung mi 'dzin pa dang 'dzin pa gnyis gsungs na'ang / 'dir 'dzin dgos te shin tu myur ba'i lam yin pas so/ /de nas mgo bo mjing pa bsgyur bya zhing / zhes pa mgo bo g.yas su bskor ba gsum/ lnga'am/ bdun/ g.yon du'ang de dang grangs mnyam pa/ de nas rlung btang / rlung kha sbyar gcig la mgo bo'i bzhi lta bu tshar na yang mi bya/ rlung kha sbyar re la re re bya ste/ mgo bo la kha sbyar bzhi'o/ /mgo bo mdun rgyab tu thang gi dkrugs pa lan gsum sogs g.yas g.yon du dpung pa gnyis kyi steng du rna ba gnyis sleb pa lan gsum/ dpung pa'i steng du lkog ko 'jog pa myur ba lan gsum sogs te mgo bo'i bzhi'o/ /lag pa gnyis ni so sor g.yab/ /ces pa/ lag pa g.yas mgo bo la bskor te/ g.yas phyogs la rgyang gi dkrug pa lan gsum/ g.yon yang de bzhin no/ /lag pa gnyis ka mgo la bskor te dkrug pa lan gsum/ lag pa g.yas thad ka la brkyangs te sgrog rus la brdeg pa lan gsum/ g.yon kyang de bzhin no/ /lag pa gnyis ka mgo bo la bskor te dkrug pa lan gsum/ lag pa g.yas thad kar brkyangs te sgrog rus la brdeg pa lan gsum/ g.yon kyang de bzhin no/ /gnyis ka bsnol brdeg gsum te bzhi'o/ /rkang pa gnyis kyang drag tu dkrug /ces pa g.yas mdun du dkrug g.yon rgyab tu dkrug pa gsum gsum de bzlog pa gsum gsum/ g.yas g.yas su/ g.yon g.yon du dkrug pa gsum/ bzlog pa g.yas g.yon du/ g.yon g.yas su dkrug pa gsum gsum ste rkang pa'i bzhi'o/ /dang po lag bkru lta bu ste/ gnyis pa lag ldog brang la sbyar/ /zhes sogs lus sbyong nyi shu pa'ang bya/ 'di kha cig lam 'bras zha ma lugs kyi gdam ngag yin gyi/ sa lugs la med gsungs kyang yod de gzhung bshad zla rgyal ma sogs su gsal bar bshad pa'i phyir ro/ lus sbyong nyi shu pa 'di la/ mgo bzhi has 'debs nur nur dang /

bya ba zhig kyang 'byung ste/ 'di ni bslan ti phu ba'i gdam ngag rtsi ri ba'i ras pa rnams kyi yin gyi/ dges rdor bde mchog gang gi yang lus sbyong ma yin/ 'on kyang nad sogs la phan par 'dug pas shes par byas la/ nad pa sogs phal pa la ston pa ni legs kyi/ gdam ngag 'di lta bu dang bsre bar ga la rung / de dag gis ni lus sbyang ba'o/ /gnyis pa ngag sbyang ba ni/ de'i 'phro la ngal bso ba'i tshul gyi ngag smra bcad pa'o/ /gsum pa yid sbyang ba la/ gsal ba rang so bzung ba dang / lhug pa rang so bzung ba gnyis kyi/ dang po ni/ snang ba 'di rang gi sems yin/ sems kyi ngo bo yang rang rig rang gsal tsam snyam pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni lhug pa ma bcos pa/ so ma/ rang mdangs/ gnyug ma bya ba ming gi rnam grangs yin/ skad dod rdo ha bya ba zhig las med/ de rang so bzung ba/ sems gsal rig tsam de'i rang gi ngo bo cir yang ma grub pa stong pa nyid spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral ba yin snyam du blo thag bcad pa ste yid sbyang ba'o/ /bzhi pa lus gnad la dbab pa ni/ lus rnam snang gi chos drug dang ldan par bya ba ste/ rkang pa rdo rje'i skyil krung lag pa mnyam bzhag rgal tshigs drang po/ lce ya rkan la sbyar/ mig thad la 'dzum pa med par blta bar/ so dang mchu mnyam par byas pa'o/ /lnga pa ngag gnad la dbab pa ni/ sna bug g.yas pa la shes pa gtad la rlung gnyis ka nas phyir 'bud/ g.yon la gtad de yang de bzhin/ gnyis ka la gtad de gnyis ka nas 'bud do/ /kha cig g.yas nas 'bud tshe g.yon bkag g.yon nas 'bud tshe g.yas bkag zer te/ rang lugs snga ma'o/ /drug pa yid gnad la dbab pa ni/ sems skyo ba'i khang par bsam gtan 'khor bya ba yin pas/ de'i ngang la sems skyo chad de bzhag pa'o/ /bdun pa byang chub kyi sems bsgom pa ni/ sems can gyi don du tshe gcig lus gcig la sangs rgyas 'thob par bya/ de'i ched du bdag gis lam zab mo nyams su bsgom snyam pa'o/

/brgyad pa lha bsgom pa ni/ rang yi dam gyi lha'i nga rgyal rgyun du byed pa de kas khyab pa yin/ dgu pa bla ma bsgom pa ni/ rang gi spyi bor bla ma yi dam gyi lhar bsgoms la/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo bla ma dam pas bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlabs du gsol/ zhes brjod pa ste sngon du 'gro ba bsam gtan gyi yan lag dgu'o/ /'di ni thun gyi sngon 'gro ma gtogs pa'i gnas skabs gzhan du yang byas pas rung ngo / /de dag gis sngon 'gro'i chos rnams bstan nas/ dngos gzhi rim pa gnyis kyi rnal 'byor la gnyis/ bskyed pa'i rim pa dang / rdzogs pa'i rim pa'o/ /dang po ni/ chos kyi rje'i yig cha gcig dang / rnying pa dang / dkar gyi yig char/ rang kyai rdor/ bde mchog gang rung bsgom par bshad pas/ bde mchog gi rnal 'byor bsgom na/ rang phyi'i he ru ka la dmigs nas lus dkyil tsam bsgom la rdzogs rim la 'jug 'dir lam 'bras pa rkyang yin pas/ lam 'bras dang bstun nas 'chad pas/ skyabs 'gro nas brtsams te bskyed rim bzlas pa/ dkyil 'khor bsdu ba'i bar byas shing / rdo rje'i glu dang bsngo ba ma byas pa'i gong der bskyed rim gyi dmigs pa lam 'bras su bshad pa bzhin/ spyan dbu ma nas/ lha'i zhal phyag sku mdog phyag mtshan sogs rang lha yab yum du gsal bar gyur gyi bar du bsgom ste/ rten bskyed pa'i rim pa mdor bsdus te bsgom tshul lo/ /gnyis pa rdzogs pa'i rim pa bsgom pa'i tshul ni/ gnas dben par stan bde ba la 'dug ste/ khrid yig rnams su spyir pho brang lnga brje ba yin na'ang / khyad par du snying kha rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i rtsa la gnad du bsnun zhes 'byung bas/ snying kha'i 'khor lo la brten pa yin/ 'di la bla ma lung phu ba bya ba'am/ 'dag pa kun rgyal ba bya ba'am/ kha cig chos rje pas mdzad kyang zer ba'i khrid yig cig na/ rlung sbyor bdun sngon du 'gro dgos pa'i bshad pa yod pa mi 'thad de/

lam 'di cig char ba kho na yin pa'i phyir ro/ /cig char ma yin pa sbyor drug lta bu la'ang rlung sbyor bzhi las ma bshad na lam myur chung 'di la lta smos kyang ci dgos/ des na thog ma nyid nas dmigs pa'i dngos gzhi la sems 'dzin no/ /de la stan 'bol ba'i steng du glang po'i rna ba lta bu'i 'phrul 'khor bya ba/ rkang pa gnyis mthil sprad pus mo gnyis kyi steng du lag mthil bzhag sde pa'i mgron zan lta bu 'jim pa la bzos pa'i so btang pa'am/ shing la bzos pa shin tu 'jam pa 'phangs su sor gsum/ mtheb mdzub gnyis kyi bar du shong tsam pa zhig gos dar ram/ snam bu 'jam pos dkris la 'phong 'og bshang lam gyi 'og tu gzhug 'di'i dgos pa ni/ lam 'di la gegs mi 'byung ngo zhes 'byung bas/ spyir lam 'bras pa lte ba la gnad du bsnun pas gegs chung / gsang 'dus pa dang / sbyor drug pa snying kha dang spyi bor bsnun pas gegs che/ de yang sbyor drug pa srog rtsol dang po'i skabs su nyams snang la ka ba lta bu gcig 'byung / de'i nang na lha dang dkyil 'khor dang bcas pa mthong ngo / /de'i nang na'ang ka ba lta bu gcig de 'dra mang po nyams su 'byung / de nang gi rtsa dang / rtsa'i nang gi rtsa mthong ba yin/ de la 'byams na thod pa gas te 'chi/ de la ye shes la 'jug pa'i 'pho ba bya ba yin zhes rtsa rgyud nyid las gsungs/ gegs de chos rje bla ma'i slob ma dge slong bsod dbang bya ba zhig la'ang phyis byung / de'i bsal thabs sbyor drug pa mang pos ma thon/ bla ma dbang rgyal gyis 'di'i gdam ngag bshang lam 'gags pa 'di mthong ba yin nam/ khong rang gi nyams la shar ba yin nam snyam/ khong na re/ rtsa ba 'dzin pa'i gdam ngag ces 'di byed/ 'dis gegs sel te 'di byas na spyi bo nas rlung mi 'gro /dper na thal khang gi sgo brtsigs na bu gu nas rlung mi yong ba bzhin zer/ de ltar byas tsa na/ 'dir yang bshang lam bkag pas steng nas rlung mi 'byung bas/

lam 'di bsgom pa la gegs mi 'byung ngo / /zhes gsungs/ des na rkang pa'i spyod lam mo/ rgal tshigs drang po/ mig la sogs pa spyi dang 'dra/ rang dmigs pa'i rim pa ni/ rang gi byang khog tu/ glo ba dkar po padma dkar po 'dab brgyad kyi tshul du kha phub pa/ mchin pa smug po kha gyen bstan gyi padma dmar po 'dab brgyad/ de gnyis kyi bar na snying yod la/ snying gi rtsa mdud phar 'brel tshur 'brel byas pa hūm̐ cha lnga pa'i rnam par gnas pa de/ thugs rdo rje mi bskyod pa/ gnas kyi nges pa snying khar/ tshad kyi nges pa sor gcig tsam sku mdog sngon po/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum rus rgyan sogs/ sngar bskyed rim du gsal na des chog ma gsal na 'dir gsal mi dgos/ de'i pang na yum mā ma ki sku mdog sngon mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud pa'o/ /de nas 'og rlung ni 'khor los bkag bzhin pa yin pas 'then mi dgos/ steng rlung has drangs la sib kyi bsgags bya ba yin pas/ rgal tshigs sgur byas sna sa la reg tsam byas nas rlung ha'i sgras drangs la/ rgal pa bsrangs nas kha sna gsum ka nas sib kyi lte bar gzhug snying kha nas mar 'gro tsa na snying kha'i lha yab yum 'dar khril li li byung bar bsam/ rlung lte bar gnas pa'i tshe snying kha'i yab yum la shes pa gtad do/ /'di ni dmigs pa snying khar gtod kyang rlung lte bar 'dzin pa phyag len yin/ de ltar sgom pa'i tshe shes pa dkar lam lam/ dmar lam lam byung na/ srog thur bsre mi nus dus gegs su 'gro bas thun gtong ma ran yang sbyor ba glod/ bsku mnye bya/ chang gsar pa dang / sha rul bsum yin pas lus gso/ mgo na skam byung na/ rtsa 'debs brdab/ des zhi ba'ang srid ma sel na sbyor ba glod de dmigs pa'i rim pa dang po song ste rtsa ba'i dmigs pa'o/ /mnyam bzhag tu dmigs pa de ltar du bsgoms pa'i rjes thob tu 'phrul 'khor bya ste/

/de la bdun du byed pa dang / bcu bzhir byed pa dang / so bzhir byed pa rnams yod kyang / 'dir khrid yig tu rtsa ba'i dmigs pa bdun yin/ de la mkha' 'degs rigs gsum spyi tshugs dang / /phan tshun 'phang dang lus zungs bskyed/ /dpung 'degs rigs gnyis gang na sel/ gtun brdungs rtsa ba'i 'phrul 'khor yin/ /zhes te/ mkhal 'degs ni/ lus skyil krung bcas la rdo rje khu tshur nu ma gnyis kyi steng du bzhag rlung kha sbyar drag tu bzung / de nas khu tshur kha gyen bstan mkhal steng du bzhag gsham bstan la ma bral bar mkhal ma gyen du 'then no/ /spyi tshugs ni rlung bzung la/ spyi bo gdan khar bzhag rkang pa gyen du brkyangs/ g.yas g.yon du mda' 'then pa lta bur bya ba dang / rang sar brkyangs pa dang / bsnol te brkyangs pa dang / skyil krung du bya ba ste byis pa'i so skye re bzhin no/ /phan tshun 'phang ba ni/ lag pa g.yas 'dzog bsgrengs pa skyil krung la bskor la rtsibs ma la brdabs te g.yon du brkyangs pa g.yon pas rim gyis ded/ g.yon de ldog lus zungs bskyed pa ni/ rlung bzung rkang pa spyi bor bsnol ba'am/ thal mo lta bur bya ba'o/ /dpung 'degs ni rlung bzung gsham stan la ma bral ba'i ngang nas lus gcu'o/ /gang na sel na/ rlung bzung sor mo bsnol bas ltag pa dgab/ gru mo thad kar brkyangs la mig thad ka gcig la gtad/ mgo bo phar 'phul/ lag pas tshur 'phul ba'o/ /gtun brdungs ni/ skyil krung bcas rlung bzung khu tshur sa la btsugs/ skyil krung 'degs shing bsdebs pa'o/ /rtsa ba'i dmigs pa 'phrul 'khor dang bcas pa bstan zin to/ /yan lag gi dmigs pa ni/ lam 'dir khams 'dus pa gsum ka'i gnad cung zad re ston/ de dag la thig le gyen du 'dren pa'i man ngag re cis kyang dgos la/ de'i tshul gyi dmigs pa ni/ lus skyil krung ngam/ glang po'i rna ba gang rung bya/ dang po ltar na rlung gnyis ka bzung /

rdo rje nor bu'i sked nas bdud bzhis mi bshig pa'i hūṃ rtsa'i tshul du yod pa gsal gdab/ de nas spyi bo 'khor lo'i bar du rtsa dbu ma mdog dkar ba/ rang bzhin mnyen pa/ sbom phra rta rnga tsam pa zhig bsam/ spyi bo'i 'khor lo'i dbus su haṃ yig dkar po mgo thur bstan bsam/ 'og gi hūm̐ me'i rang bzhin de las me stag mang po chad cing byung / dbu ma'i nang na yar song / haṃ zhu thig le g.yos pas bde bas lus thams cad khyab ste/ yang me rnams kyis gzhan du 'phor mi ster/ khyad par hūm̐ gi rdo rje nor bur 'bab pa bsrung te/ rdza ma'i gzer bzhin no/ /de ltar rtsa ba'i dmigs pa dang / yan lag gi dmigs pa 'di yun ring du bsgoms na bden pa mthong ba yan chad kyi rtogs pa khyad par can bskyed do/ /rtsa ba'i dmigs pa'i lha'i phyag mtshan nyi zla sogs 'dzin pa khrid yig kha rer bshad pa ni ma dag pa dang nor ba yin no/ /'phrul 'khor yang chos rje pa'i khrid yig tu bdun po 'di nyid bshad pa yin/ rdo rje 'chang chen bla ma'i gsung / /rang nyid dran pa gso phyir dang / /blo brtul gzhan la'ang phan pa'i phyir/ /kun dgas snag med tshos yig bgyis/ /de las dge ba gang thob des/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i gsung nyan zhing / /bla ma'i gsung bzhin bsgrub pa dang / /bla ma khyed bzhin bdag gyur cig /lam zab mo sbas te bshad pa'i zin bris kyi yi ge 'di ni/ chos kyi rje rdo rje 'chang chen po kun dga' bzang po'i zhabs rdul yan lag mchog gis gus pas len pa shākya'i dge slong kun dga' blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos lo nyi shu lon pa'i tshe/ dpal e wam̐ chos ldan yon tan rin po che'i 'byung gnas su bris pa'o/ /zin bris kyi yi ge dang 'di ni rang gi bla ma'i gsung gang zin bris pa yin gyi gzhan gyi zin bris mgo mjug brjes pa ma yin pas rang nyid yid ches pa lags/ zhes pa de rnams kun dga' blo gros gsung rab las 'byung tshul bstan zin nas/

spyi don gsum pa bdag chen chos rje'i gsung rab las 'byung tshul bshad pa ni/ rgyal ba gnyis pa mus chen sems dpa' chen po'i gsung la bdag chen rdo rje 'chang blo gros rgyal mtshan gyis zin bris su mdzad pa'i lam sbas bshad kyi khrid yig las 'di ltar 'byung ste/ dpal ldan mthu stobs dbang phyug dang / /rje btsun dam pa snying po'i zhabs/ /dbyer med dkon mchog rgyal mtshan la/ /btud de khrid tshul tho tsam bri/ /de'ang rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug birwa pas/ rje sa skya pa chen po la dngos su gnang ba'i gdams pa dpal sa skya'i lcags ri'i khong nas mi 'da' ba'i chos zab bzhir grags pa'i nang nas lam sbas te bshad pa la mchog bsgrub pa dang / thun mong gi dngos grub bsgrub pa'i thabs gnyis las/ 'dir mchog gi dngos grub tshe 'dir rdo rje 'chang chen po mngon du byed pa'i thabs rdo rje'i lus kyi 'phrul 'khor la brten nas dbang bzhi'i lam cig char du nyams su len pa'i tshul la/ de'ang mtshan nyid ldan pa'i rdo rje slob dpon gyis/ slob ma la lam rgyas pa'i khrid yongs su rdzogs pa'am/ ma rdzogs kyang rung ste dbang dang dam tshig ldan pa tshul bzhin du khrid cing gdams pa ston pa la/ sngon 'gro dang / dngos gzhi gnyis las/ dang po la thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gro gnyis kyi/ dang po/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed bsags sbyang gi rnal 'byor rnams lam 'bras bzhin zhag grangs ci rigs su bya/ gnyis pa la byin rlabs 'jug pa bla ma'i rnal 'byor dang / rdzogs rim gyi rten bskyed pa'i rim pa gnyis thun re la'ang zung 'brel du bsgom par mdzad de/ de'ang bsam gtan gyi stan la lus gnad dang ldan pas skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngon du song nas/ bdag gi spyi bor rin po che'i khri pad nyi zla ba'i gdan gyi steng du/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo bla ma dam pa he ru ka phyag bcu drug pa'am/

rdo rje 'chang chen po'i rnam pa can gsal btab la gnas gsum du yi ge gsum bsgom/ thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od 'phros pas/ bla ma brgyud pa/ yi dam/ sangs rgyas/ byang sems/ mkha' 'gro bsrung ma thams cad spyan drangs la bstim ste/ skyabs gnas kun 'dus kyi ngo bor dmigs shing / gus 'dud drag po dang bcas pas/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo bla ma dam pa la gsol ba 'debs so/ /bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlabs tu gsol/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pa gsol gdab drag po byas pa'i mthar bla ma nyid byang sems bde ba chen po'i rnam par zhu ste/ spyi bor thim pas lus ngag yid gsum dang sku gsung thugs dbyer med du 'dres par bsam la mnyam par gzhag nyams ci skyes byung rgyal du bskyangs/ gnyis pa bskyed pa'i rim pa ni/ de nyid kyi rjes su bsgom ste/ 'dir dbang po rnon po'i lam yin pas mngon rtogs rgyas pa bsgom mi dgos/ bdag bla mas dkyil 'khor du bcug pa'i dus su dpal kyai rdo rjer bskyed/ de la ye shes pa bcug dbang bskur phyin chad kyai rdo rjer gyur pa yin snyam pa byas la/ rang skad cig gis kyai rdo rje zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa yum dang bcas pa gsal btab la/ sku yongs su rdzogs pa la dmigs pa gtad cing bsgom/ lam rgyas pa ltar dmigs pa dum sgrigs su byas nas bsgom mi dgos zhes gsungs so/ /de dag ni sngon du 'gro ba'o/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi la/ rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dmigs pa gnyis kyi/ dang po/ bca' ba lus kyi gnad/ bsgom pa dmigs pa'i gnad/ dgang ba rlung gi gnad gsum las/ dang po ni/ 'di nyid rdo rje lus kyi 'phrul 'khor la brten nas nyams su len pa yin pas/ rdza'am shing la byas pa'i 'khor lo dpangs su sor drug pa/ sbom du mtheb mdzub gnyis rtse sprad pa'i bar du bcod pa/ rtse mo cung zad phra zhing shin tu 'jam pa tshags byas te bsam gtan gyi dngos gzhi la 'jug pa'i tshe/

'bol la sogs pa'i stan bde ba la gnas nas skyabs 'gro nas yi dam bsgom pa'i bar sngar bzhin bya/ de nas lus glang po'i rna ba lta bu'i skyil krung bca'/ zhes pa'i don sems skyil sems dpa'i skyil mo krung yangs par bya/ sngar gyi 'khor lo srin bu'i lam gyi thad kar bzhag la/ brla gnyis re mos 'degs pa dang / 'og rlung 'dren pa dang bstun te srin bu'i lam bsdams nas 'khor lo'i steng du bzhag cung zad mtho bas mi bde na smad ces pa brnag po che'i 'og tu btegs 'tshams pa gzhug lag pa gnyis pus mo la bkab/ tshigs pa drang bor bsrangs te bca' ba lus kyi gnad do/ /gnyis pa ni/ lus la rang bzhin gyi gnas tshul glo ba kha thur bstan/ mchin pa ldeb la 'byar te gnas pa las/ de gnyis sgom dus gong 'og brjes te/ glo ba padma dkar po kha gyen la bstan pa/ mchin pa padma dmar smug 'dab brgyad kha thur la bstan pa/ de gnyis rtse mo cung zad bsnol ba gzhal yas khang gi tshul du bsam/ rdo rje lus kyi gnas lugs la/ snying gi rtse thur la bstan nas gnas kyang blos gyen la bslangs te/ padma gnyis kyi bar la gnas par bsam/ snying de'i dbus su rtsa gsum 'dus pa'i mdud pa hūm̐ gi gzugs su grub pa la dmigs pa gtad/ de nas rdo rje mkha' 'gro bsgom ste/ snying dbus kyi hūm̐ de he ru ka sku mdog sngo nag spyan gsum dmar zhing zlum pa mche ba gtsigs shing / phyag gnyis rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ zhabs g.yas nyi steng du brkyangs/ g.yon zla steng du bskums/ dbu'i gtsug tor dang bcas shing ral pa lnga g.yon du 'phyang ba ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs par bsgom/ yum dran pa tsam las zhal phyag rgyas par gsal gdab mi dgos gsungs/ de yang hūm̐ de rang bzhin gyi he ru ka'i rnam par gnas pa la gsal 'debs pa yin gyi/ sa bon lta bur gyur nas bsgom pa ni ma yin no/

/de ni bsgom pa dmigs pa'i gnad do/ /gsum pa dgang ba rlung gi gnad ni/ rlung ro lan gsum phyir bus la cung zad gcer/ lce rkan la sbyar/ mig cung zad bgrad/ spyi bo sa la thug btud de yin nam/par steng rlung ha'i gdangs kyis drangs shing / rngub ste ro stod dkrug cing sib kyis mnan/ steng 'og gi rlung kha sbyar la/ sems kyi dmigs pa thugs rdo rje'i gdan gyi pad 'dab rnams 'dar khri li li g.yo bar bsam mo/ /mi thub na dal bus btang / yang spyi bo sa la thug par brngubs te/ rlung sa len ma bya ba yin gsungs/ de ltar rtsa ba'i 'phrul 'khor bdun dang spel zhing bsgoms pas snang ba dkar dmar lam 'ong zhes pa'i don dkar lam lam byung na 'ong ba'i rtags/ dmar lam lam byung na mi 'ong pa'i rtags yin pas/ zas bcud can btang zhing bsgom/ de ltar dmigs pa dang po bsgom pas gal te 'pho ba snyam byed/ snying kha tsha lam lam byed na btsan phong btang / 'o dod 'bod/ zas bcud can btang / des nges par sel lo/ /gnyis pa yan lag gi dmigs pa ni/ 'bar dang g.yo ba brtan pa dang / /zhes pa'i don nyams su len pa yin te/ lus skyil krung / lag pa mthe bos srin lag gi rtsa ba mnan pa'i rdo rje khu tshur snying khar bsnol la/ sems kyi dmigs pa lus kyi spyi gtsug nas gsang gnas kyi bar la rtsa dbu ma sbom 'phra gro sog tsam pa kha dog dmar po ya yo dang khyag khyog med pa thad la sir ba zhig bsam/ rdo rje'i rtsa bar bdud bzhis zil gyis mi non pa'i hūm̐ me 'bar ba mgo gyen bstan gcig bsam/ spyi gtsug tu byang sems kyis gang ba'i ham̐ mgo thur bstan gcig bsam/ mgo sa la btud de/ rlung sna bug gnyis ka nas brngubs la kha sbyar bas/ hūm̐ las hūm̐ me 'bar ba mang po chad de dbu ma na yar mar 'phro song bas haṃ gi byang sems zhu nas/ spyi bo'i rtsa 'dab so gnyis mer gyis gang bar bsam/ de'ang hūm̐ des them bu bkag pa bzhin bsgom la mar 'dzag pa lta bu ni ma yin no/

/skabs su man ngag bzhin ha ring bgrang / de la gsal ba dang / mgrin pa snying kha'i 'khor lo rnams kyang gang bar bsam/ mthar thug lus thams cad gang bar bsgom ste/ bde bzhin du stong / stong bzhin du bde ba/ bde stong gnyis med du bsam/ lus lha sku 'ja' tshon lta bu la dmigs pa gtad do/ /nyams ci skyes byung rgyal du bskyangs/ de dag gi skabs su rngul cher byung na lag pas skam skam mnye/ steng du gcun drags pas sna khrag byung na gan rkyal du nyal te cung zad mid la lag pa gnyis rdo rje khu tshur grim par brkyangs pas chad/ des ma chod na sgro ba bkyig pa lag len bzhin bya/ 'dzag pa byung na dbang gsum pa'i lam bzhin no/ /de ltar rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dmigs pa re mos su bsgom ste dngos gzhi dang / gzhan rnams ni khrid yig tu gsal la/ khrid yig tu glo ba steng du dang / mchin pa 'og tu bsgom par gsungs la/ 'dir steng 'og brje ba ni bla ma'i man ngag gi glo ba dang snying rtsa 'brel pas las dang po pa la snying gyen du slong ba'i dmigs pa bde ba'i phyir yin gsungs/ 'khrul 'khor so gnyis ni rtsa ba nas ma bshad pas cis kyang dgos pa ma yin la/ byas na'ang 'gal ba med ces gsungs so/ /lam sbas te bshad pa'i man ngag gi nying khu/ rje btsun dam pa dkon mchog rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i gsung las ji ltar byon pa bzhin/ 'khon gyi rigs can bya btang ma ti'i ming can gyis rang gi brjed byang tsam du yi ger bkod pa la/ chos bdag mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis bzod par mdzad nas byin gyis brlabs tu gsol/ bdag cag la zab mo bsgrub pa'i rnal 'byor pa rnams kyi bar du gcod pa zhi zhing / rims gnyis kyi rnal 'byor mthar phyin te/ sems can dpag tu med pa'i don byed par gyur cig ces pa de rnams kyis bdag chen chos rje'i gsung rab las 'byung tshul bstan zin nas/ spyi don bzhi pa kun dga' lhun grub gsung rab las 'byung tshul bshad pa ni/

chos rje lha mchog seṅge'i gsung bzhin/ btsun pa kun dga' lhun grub kyis zin bris su byas pa'i lam sbas bshad kyi khrid yig las 'di ltar 'byung ste/ na mo bi ru pa ye/ gang gi zhabs pad g.yo med gus bsten na/ /tshe 'dir phyag chen mchog gi dngos grub kyang / /nges par stsol mdzad bla ma dam pa yi/ /zhabs pad dri ma med la phyag 'tshal nas/ /zab don gdams pa'i brjed tho cung zad bri/ /de la 'dir dpal stobs kyi mgon po rje btsun birwa pa'i zhal gdams rje sa skya pa chen po la dngos su gnang ba zab mo bzhir grags pa'i nang tshan lam sbas te bshad pa la gnyis/ mchog gi dngos grub bsgrub pa dang / thun mong gi dngos grub bsgrub pa'o/ /dang po ni/ slob ma rang nyid la lam 'bras thob pa la bstan par bya ba yin gyis/ su thod thod la mi bstan gsungs/ dpal sa skya pa chen pos ni/ rgya gar sindhu'i dge slong la lam 'di kho na bstan pas grol bar bshad kyang / lam 'di gang zag dbang po yang rab kyi lam yin pas deng sang gi gang zag rnams la da lta'i phyag len 'di mi mdzad kha med snang ngo / /de lta bu'i lam khrid pa la sngon 'gro dang dngos gzhi'i rnal 'byor gnyis las/ dang po ni/ /bsag sbyang gnyis te lam 'bras kyi sngon 'gro spyi dang 'dra'o/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i rnal 'byor la bskyed rdzogs gnyis las/ dang po bla mas dbang bskur ba'i dus su/ rang nyid kyi phung khams skye mched lhar bskyed cing mdor na yan lag bzhi rdzogs su byas pa de nyid gsal gdab pa ste/ rang nyid sna tshogs padma dang nyi ma bdud bzhi brtsegs pa'i gdan gyi steng du skad cig gis kyai rdo rje zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa yab yum du lam ste bsgom pa'o/ /gnyis pa rdzogs pa'i rim pa la gnyis/ gzhi rtsa ba'i dmigs pa dang / yan lag gi dmigs pa'o/ /dang po la mnyam gzhag dang rjes thob gnyis las/ dang po la bca' ba lus kyi gnad/

bsgom pa dmigs pa'i gnad/ dgang ba rlung gi gnad do/ /dang po ni/ /skyabs sems sngon du song nas/ stan ha cang 'thug pa ma yin pa shin tu kha snyoms pa'i steng du skyil krung glang po'i rna ba ltar bcas/ zhes pa rkang pa'i brang ba gnyis sbyar 'phongs kyi sa 'dzugs gnyis su snam bu bzhi bltab tsam re bcug la lus brtan brlings la khel bar byas/ ngag rlung rgyu ba sor bzhag mig nam mkhar 'byed 'dzum med par byas/ sems 'das ma 'ongs gang la yang ma 'phros par cung zad mnyam par bzhag de nas rang nyid lhar gsal ba'i thugs khar glo ba padma dkar po kha gyen du blta ba/ mchin pa padma dmar po kha thur du blta ba kha sprod dam gur bltabs su yod pa lha'i gzhal yas khang yin snyam du bsam pa'o/ /de'i dbus su snying mgo gyen du bstan pa'i dbus su rtsa dbu ma la ro rkyang 'khril ba'i tshul gyi yi ge hūm̐ mthing shun lta bu mgo thur la lta ba zhig bsam la de nyid la yid rtse gcig tu bzhag pa'o/ /de nas snying kha'i dbus kyi hūm̐ de nyid rgyur gyur pa'i tshul gyis thugs rdo rje zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyi rdo rje dang dril bu bsnol nas 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa spyan gsum dang ldan pa zhal mche ba gtsigs pa/ dbu skra dmar ser gyen du brdzes pa dbu'i gtsug tor dang bcas pa/ rus pa'i rgyan drug gis brgyan pa/ zhabs gnyis sa ga'i bstabs su bzhugs pa mthe bong gi sor tshigs tsam/ de'i pang na yum rdo rje bdag med ma sku mdog sogs gzhan dang 'dra ba'i yab yum kyis sku tshang ma shin tu gsal ba'i spyan dbu ma sogs nas shin tu gsal bar ma gyur gyi bar du 'dzin pa'o/ /gsum pa dgang ba rlung gi man ngag ni/ lus kyi spyod lam sogs sngar bzhin la rlung sa len ma/ sna sa la reg pa tsam gyi sgra med du drangs rjes kha sbyor gyi tshul du mnan pas snying kha'i thugs rdo rje yab yum/ 'khar sder chus bkang pa la dbyug gu bsnun pa bzhin 'dar khril li li khril ba bsams te rlung sbyor de lta bu nyi shu rtsa gcig la thun re rer byas pa'i thun bzhi ni kun la 'gre'o/

/de ltar nyams su blangs pas snang ba'i dngos po thams cad kha dog lngar 'char na ye shes skye ba'i sna 'dren yin pas nan tan bskyed la nyams su blang / yang snang ba dkar lam mam dmar lam kho nar 'char na rlung gi rtags yin pas thun bskum zas bcud can bsten pa'o/ /gnyis pa rjes thob kyi dmigs pa ni/ rtsa ba'i 'phrul 'khor bcu gnyis la/ /yan lag 'phrul 'khor rnam pa bcu/ /yan lag gi ni yan lag brgyad/ /sbas bshad 'phrul 'khor sum cur bzhed/ /ces pa/ chos rje dpal ldan tshul khrims pa'i yig cha ltar nyams su len pa'o/ /dmigs pa bsdus par ston pa'i tshe yig cha'i lung tsam las mi mdzad kyang lam gyi babs la gzhig na 'phrul 'khor rnams ston pa byung na cis kyang legs par bsam mo/ /gnyis pa yan lag gi dmigs pa ni lus rdo rje'i skyil krung lag pa rdo rje khu tshur snying khar bsnol la he ru ka zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa yab yum du gsal ba'i dbus su spyi gtsug nas gsang gnas kyi bar du rtsa dbu ma gro sog 'bring po tsam gcig gi ya snar haṃ dkar po mgo thur bstan/ ma snar hūm̐ dmar nag cig bsam/ de nas ngag gi rlung sgra dang bcas pa sa len gyi tshul gyis drangs/ sems kyi gsang gnas kyi bu ga'i hūm̐ bdud bzhis zil gyis mi non pa de las hūm̐ me 'bar bzhin pa'i phreng ba rgyun ma chad par dbu ma'i nang na yar byon/ de'i dus rgya mtsho ri rab la bkan/ ro 'dzin rang gi gnas su bskyal/ dbang po'i mchog steng du bgrad/ stobs kyis drangs pa'i hūm̐ de spyi bo'i haṃ la reg pa de'i tshe lus kyi 'phrul 'khor rnams glod pas haṃ yig las byang chub kyi sems them bu btang pa ltar 'dzag spyi bo'i rtsa 'dab sum cu rtsa gnyis gang / de bzhin du rim gyis mgrin pa dang snying kha dang lte ba'i rtsa 'dab rnams gang / mthar lus thams cad kyang gang bas sems nyid bde ba chen po'i ye shes kyi ngo bor skyes/

bde chen gyi ye shes de nyid ngo bo stong pa las ma 'das/ des na de gnyis gcig gis gcig mi 'gog pas bde stong zung 'jug gi ye shes kyi ngo bor bsgom/ de nyid gzugs sku 'ja' tshon lta bu mtshan dpes spras pa'i he ru ka zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa yum dang bcas par bsgom zhing de lta bu'i zung 'jug gi ngang la mnyam par bzhag cing bskyangs pas zla ba drug la sogs pa na bden pa mthong ba'i ye shes skye zhing / slar yang dbu ma'i nang na yar hūm̐ yig 'od 'bar bzhin pa 'phro bar bsgom pa'o/ /yang dbang bzhi stan thog gcig tu nyams su len pa'i gdam ngag yin gsungs pa'i don ni/ skad cig gis he ru ka yab yum du bsgom pa ni bum dbang gi lam spyi bo sogs rnams la gnad du bsnun pa gsang dbang gi lam/ haṃ las babs pa'i byang sems kyis lus kyi rtsa gnas sogs gang ba shes rab ye shes kyi lam/ slar yang hūm̐ yig me 'bar ba gyen du 'gro bar bsgom pa bzhi pa'i lam yin no gsungs/ zin bris 'ga' zhig las lam 'di'i sngon 'gror/ bsam gtan gyi yan lag dgu byed pa la dgag pa mdzad nas mi dgos par bzhed kyang / sa skya paṇa chen gyi khrid yig gnyis char las lam thams cad kyi sngon du 'gro ba bsam gtan gyi yan lag dgu sngon du song nas zhes gsungs pas bsam gtan gyi yan lag dgu cis kyang dgos par mngon no/ /mi dgos par bzhad pa rje btsun a nanda bha dra'i gsung rgyun yin gsungs kyang gsung rgyun ma zin par mngon no// ༈ /spyi don gnyis pa thun mong gi dngos grub bsgrub pa ni grub chen bcu dang / phra mo brgyad de/ de dag gi yi ge grub chen buddha shrīs mdzad pa'i lung re mdzad kyin 'dug go /'bar dang g.yo dang brtan po zhes sogs kyi rdo rje'i tshig gi 'bru gnyer ba sogs go don rgyas par dpal ldan sa skya paṇḍi tas mdzad pa'i gsung rab la zhib tu rtogs par bya'o/

/grub chen birwa pa'i zab don gdams pa'i bcud/ /brtse chen kun dga'i gsung lam si ti'i rgyun/ /paṇa chen 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i ma dros gtam/ /blo chen kun dga'i 'phrin las bzang por bskyangs/ /dus 'dir lha mchog 'khor lo'i mgon po yi/ /zhal gyis bum pa las 'ong bdud rtsi'i rgyun/ /legs par 'thungs las kun dga'i blo gros mtsho/ /lhun gyis grub las gzhan gyis bskul ba'i ngor/ /bdud rtsi'i rgyun 'di slar yang spel bar bgyi/ /'dir 'bad dge bas phyi nang gi /rten 'brel thams cad tshogs gyur nas/ /tshe 'di nyid la 'gro ba yi/ /don du sangs rgyas nyid thob shog /ces pa 'di yang rje btsun rdo rje 'chang lha mchog seṅge'i zhabs rdul spyi bos len pa shākya'i btsun pa kun dga' lhun grub la don gnyer mched grogs 'ga' yis bskul ba'i ngor dpal e wam̐ gyi chos grwa chen por zin bris su bgyis pa'o/ /sa mā sta ma ti/ zhes pa de rnams kyis kun dga' lhun grub gsung rab las 'byung tshul bstan zin to/ /'dir smras pa/ 'jigs bral dpal ldan chos skyong zhal snga nas/ /sa skya'i bla chen nyid la legs gdams pa'i/ /zab las ches zab man ngag snying po'i khrid/ /'di 'dra thos shing bsgom pa skal ba bzang / /tshul 'di bdag chen chos rje'i khrid yig bzhin/ /rang gi bla ma'i drung du legs thob pa/ /sa skyar gnas pa'i sngags 'chang rdo rje 'dzin/ /ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams bdag gis bsdebs/ /'di sbyar dge bas bdag cag dpon slob rnams/ /dus 'dir tshe ring nad med bstan pa rgyas/ /phyi ma lhan cig bde ba can skyes nas/ /yid la re ba'i don kun 'grub gyur cig /ces lam sbas bshad kyi khrid yig gong ma'i gsung gi bdud rtsi man ngag gi rgya mtsho zhes bya ba 'di yang / khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po rigs ldan 'jam pa'i dbyangs sku mched dang / rgyal ba mus pa chen po rdo rje 'chang sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan gtso bor smos pa'i yongs 'dzin chos bzhin du spyod pa bka' drin can rnams kyi zhabs rdul spyi bos len pa sa skya pa shākya'i dge bsnyen theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos/
